title: Download a scoped dynamic follow-up due Excel page
description: A salesperson downloads exactly the current selected page of the visual follow-up due report as Excel, with the same field order and filters visible in the designer. Add a bounded export endpoint to the dynamic follow-up controller. Every export request reruns the authorized preview, rechecking identity, follow-up-due menu, salesperson customer scope and validation at download time; a revoked grant returns an error and no file. Reuse ExcelExporter for typed dates and numbers and formula-safe text, and existing HTTP OperationLogMiddleware audit. No full-dataset export or model-generated SQL. Development only: no schema or migration edits, production SQL or real database execution, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused workbook and UI contract tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: A bounded POST export accepts the preview request, reruns current-user menu and data-scope checks, and returns only the selected current page as an xlsx attachment; invalid, denied or revoked requests return no workbook.

The workbook preserves catalog-selected column order and typed date and number values, escapes formula-like text, and never includes hidden or unassigned customer follow-ups or more than the configured page maximum.
The designer downloads its current selected fields, filters and page and displays denied, validation or network errors; focused workbook and UI contract tests plus safe Release build/test pass.
